description: This file defines REST API endpoints for managing notes in a FastAPI application. It includes route handlers for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes, utilizing dependency injection to obtain service instances, with error handling and documentation. The file references models and services related to notes, and uses an APIRouter to modularize the API endpoints.

classes.name: NotesService
classes.description: Service class that provides operations for notes like listing, creation, retrieval, updating, and deletion.

classes.name: NotFoundError
classes.description: Exception raised when a note with specified ID is not found.

methods.name: NotesService _get_service_from_app_state(request: Request)
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the NotesService instance from FastAPI application state, ensuring singleton behavior and lazy initialization.

methods.name: List[Note] list_notes(service: NotesService = Depends(_get_service_from_app_state))
methods.description: API handler to list all notes.

methods.name: Note create_note(payload: NoteCreate, service: NotesService = Depends(_get_service_from_app_state))
methods.description: API handler to create a new note.

methods.name: Note get_note( note_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="ID of the note to retrieve"), service: NotesService = Depends(_get_service_from_app_state), )
methods.description: API handler to retrieve a note by ID.

methods.name: Note update_note( payload: NoteUpdate, note_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="ID of the note to update"), service: NotesService = Depends(_get_service_from_app_state), )
methods.description: API handler to update an existing note by ID.

methods.name: Response delete_note( note_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="ID of the note to delete"), service: NotesService = Depends(_get_service_from_app_state), )
methods.description: API handler to delete a note by ID.
